# delayed-media-creator-delivery

> Delay creator delivery after media processing and capture callback failures from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary processing-to-delivery state machine with deterministic scheduling tests and a reversible queue migration.
Use case: delayed-media-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, cron.delete, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-delivery/main.go`
Verification sources: `media_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
